title: Pendant paths and integral generalized sun graphs
summary: A graph is integral if the spectrum of its adjacency matrix consists entirely of integers. We prove that every simple graph having a pendant path with at least three edges has an eigenvalue in $(1,2\cos(π/9)]$ and one in $[-2\cos(π/9),-1)$, and hence is not integral. This settles a conjecture of Braga, Del-Vecchio and Rodrigues (2021) on integral generalized sun graphs. The argument is matrix-theoretic: adjoining a terminal path on three new coordinates to an arbitrary real symmetric matrix produces the same spectral obstruction, and the positive interval above is optimal in this generality.…
